doc.title: Mrs. P. Thomas Agnes Brown Interview, 1960-10-12

chapter: New Orleans bands and later photographs
title: Photo of Tom with Chink Martin, Steve Loyacano and a New Orleans band
summary: Identifying the band members in a photo and describing their mutes, banjo, violin and doubling saxophones.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: Mm-hmm. So let's see. We've got another picture here.
Mm-hmm. Well, I bet I can tell you who's there. That's Chink. Chink. Chink Martin on the tuba, and he's got a...
Well, it's actually a sousaphone with an upright bell and a string bass in the picture.
And Tom is next to him on trombone. That doesn't look like Johnny. He's put on weight, but Johnny biased off him. Leo Addy is on drums. I recognize him. You do? Now, the banjo I'm not sure about.
And who is the piano player there?
Nuncio Skaglione is the name. And in front of the van, let's see. Tom doesn't have any mutes, but yes, he has one straight mute there, I see. Mm-hmm.

And then they've got a straight mute for the trumpet, and it looks like one of those old con mutes, huh? Mm-hmm. That used to come with a trumpet sort of pear-shaped. And there's a violin in front of the banjo player. Maybe Loicanna played violin.
And they've got four saxophones in front. It looks like a...
They used to double, I guess. Mm-hmm.
Soprano, alto, C melody, antenna, huh? Mm-hmm.
